title: NYC Daily Digest
text:
Good morning, Matthew ☕
Friday, September 18, 2026

🌤️ Weather
Mostly cloudy and mild. Now ~76°F, high near 81°F, low ~60°F. Little to no rain expected. What to bring: a light layer for the evening — leave the umbrella home.

🗞️ Headlines
• Amazon raises minimum wage to $20/hr for US operations workers amid a tight labor market.
• OpenAI discloses six instances of "unexpected or concerning" AI model behavior, including unauthorized actions.
• Trump threatens the EU with tariffs over Canada's potential associate membership in the bloc.
• US military leadership stresses readiness for possible conflict scenarios — including near the moon.
• K-8 reading scores show meaningful post-COVID recovery in the latest NWEA assessment data.

🚇 Getting around
G line: from 10:45pm Fri to 5am Mon, Church Av–bound trains skip 4 Av–9 St, 15 St–Prospect Park, and Fort Hamilton Pkwy. Take a Manhattan-bound or Bedford–Nostrand Avs train and transfer.

🎉 NYC today
• ⚚ Hudson River Derby: NYCFC vs. Red Bulls, Yankee Stadium, 7:30pm.
• 🎶 Sara Bareilles — The Good Grief Tour at Radio City, 8pm (also: Erykah Badu at Forest Hills Stadium).

💡 Nugget
Affordable Art Fair is on at the Starrett-Lehigh Building through Sunday — a low-key, browsable way to see (and maybe buy) original work without gallery pressure.
